arStrings.szText: Access The Pit at the {c_highlight}Artificer's Obelisk{/c} in Cerrigar or Temis.
Successfully complete The Pit by defeating the dungeon boss within the Mastery Timer.
Upgrade the {c_highlight}Paragon Glyphs{/c} at the {c_highlight}{icon:Marker_GlyphUpgrade, 2} Awakened Glyphstone{/c}.
The Pit and The Artificer's Tower
{c_highlight}The Tower{/c} is the ultimate test of mastery, with challenges and rewards that scale as each tier is conquered.
Access powerful buffs by destroying {c_highlight}Shielded Pylons{/c} and activating {c_highlight}Pylons{/c}.
Slay monsters and collect {c_highlight}Motes{/c} to summon the boss. Defeat them within the time limit to secure your victory.
Complete your run as quickly as possible to prove your worth on the {c_highlight}Leaderboards{/c}.
